build.description: Builds applications and packages for production by compiling TypeScript and generating optimized output artifacts. Builds dependent workspace packages first.

typecheck.description: Performs static TypeScript type checking without emitting compiled files. Checks dependent workspace packages first to ensure type consistency across the monorepo.

test.description: Runs automated tests with code coverage reporting to verify application behavior and prevent regressions. Builds dependent workspace packages before executing tests.

dev.description: Starts the application or package in development mode with live reload or file watching. Runs as a persistent process and disables caching because development servers are long-running.

//#format.description: Checks formatting across the monorepo using Oxfmt without modifying files. Reports formatting violations that must be resolved before merging changes.

//#format:fix.description: Automatically formats source files across the monorepo using Oxfmt. Runs the lint autofix task first and disables caching because it modifies files.

//#lint.description: Performs static code analysis across the monorepo using Oxlint to detect potential bugs, suspicious patterns, and violations of configured linting rules without modifying files.

//#lint:fix.description: Automatically fixes supported linting violations across the monorepo using Oxlint. Reports remaining issues that require manual intervention and disables caching because it modifies files.
